title: AHB Exclusive Access Sequence
description: A successful exclusive read-modify-write sequence to implement a semaphore. Master 1 acquires the lock successfully.

phases.name: Exclusive Read
phases.description: Master 1 reads the semaphore with HEXCL=1. The exclusive monitor records Master 1's ID and the address.

phases.name: Intermission
phases.description: The bus is free! Other masters can perform normal transfers, but the exclusive monitor watches for any writes to the semaphore's address.

phases.name: Exclusive Write
phases.description: Master 1 attempts to write the modified semaphore back with HEXCL=1.

phases.name: HEXOKAY Response
phases.description: The slave responds with HEXOKAY=1, indicating no other master wrote to the address during the intermission. Master 1 has the lock!
